# SDAIA Academy Course Catalog

> The SDAIA Academy course catalog: learning paths in AI Engineering and Data Science over shared Foundations, with a page for every course.

SDAIA Academy publishes this catalog of courses in data and artificial intelligence. This file lists the learning paths: a first course, then the Foundations, then two tracks, AI Engineering and Data Science, from level 200 to level 400. Each line gives a course's level, hours and status, and the courses it needs first. Every course has a Markdown page; courses marked available have a published course site with their full material. The other courses of the catalog are in the Extras file linked at the end.

- [The courses of the learning paths in one file](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/llms-full.txt)
- [Learning paths](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/paths/index.md)

## Start here

- [USE-FLU-202 · AI Productivity for Knowledge Work](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/USE-FLU-202.md): Level 200 · Apply, 30 h, Available

## Foundations

- [FN-101 · Python for Data and AI Work](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-101.md): Level 100 · Explain, 26 h, Available; Needs: USE-FLU-202
- [FN-102 · Command Line, Git and Reproducible Projects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-102.md): Level 100 · Explain, 21 h, Available; Needs: FN-101
- [FN-103 · Mathematics for Machine Learning: Vectors, Gradients and Probability](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-103.md): Level 100 · Explain, 26 h, Available; Needs: FN-101
- [FN-104 · SQL and Data Wrangling](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-104.md): Level 100 · Explain, 26 h, Available; Needs: FN-101
- [FN-105 · How Machine Learning and Language Models Work](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-105.md): Level 100 · Explain, 21 h, Available; Needs: FN-101, FN-103
- [FN-106 · Responsible Data and AI Practice in the Kingdom](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/en/courses/FN-106.md): Level 100 · Explain, 21 h, Available; Needs: FN-101, FN-105
